# `usage generate ruby`

- **Usage:** `usage generate ruby [FLAGS]`
- **Effect:** read-only
- **Source code:** [`cli/src/cli/generate/ruby.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/usage/blob/main/cli/src/cli/generate/ruby.rs)

Generate Ruby parse tables from a usage spec

The generated file is read by the `usage-rb` gem. It contains static parse tables, result classes, and a typed `parse` entry point.

## Flags

- **`-f --file <FILE>`** — A usage spec taken in as a file, use "-" to read from stdin
- **`-o --out-file <OUT_FILE>`** — File path where the generated Ruby source will be saved, or "-" for stdout

  **Effect:** modifies state

- **`-m --module <MODULE>`** — Module for the generated code (defaults to the spec's bin name)
- **`--spec <SPEC>`** — Raw string spec input
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
